stories_list.note: EU Horizon 2014-2020 funding figures (haaretz/themarker/ynet) double-count and are 38-54% higher than the official EC total of ~1.3bn EUR; also carries 2 misinterpreted claims (the '150%' statistic) and 2 imprecise claims (Genocide Convention clause framing).
No primary source (Tax Authority, State Comptroller, Bank of Israel) found for '100,000 tax offenders'; official figures speak of 'tens of thousands' of evaders and NIS billions, not a headcount.
Headline's '20 rich people' misreads an NYT donor-money ranking in which 8/20 entries are organizations/PACs, not individuals; the $2bn aggregate and Miriam Adelson's placement are accurate.
Body faithfully reproduces AHA figures and caveats; only the headline framing is imprecise.
Figures accurate; the silicon-panel efficiency comparison mixes a narrow-spectrum underwater figure with a full-spectrum silicon figure (not like-for-like).
Kan article blocked (403) both at collection and audit time; no matching 'new report' identified with confidence.
